_note: Constructed test sentences for the lexicon's behaviour. These are NOT corpus annotations — they are unit tests, written to lock in specific properties. The hard_negative block is the important one: it encodes the v1 failures this redesign exists to fix. Every v1 behaviour asserted here was verified by running v1's own scraper/flag_patterns.flag_comment().
